rows.en: Accel...!
Indeed. That enemy is only fast when it comes to escaping.
Accel...!
No kidding. The only thing that bastard's fast at is running away.
Accel...!
You're right... The only thing that enemy's fast at is running away...
The Weather Dopant... To corner him, what I need is speed...
See you.
Yeah... You got that right.
That's true. We always end up letting him get away...
True... We keep letting him get away.
Yes. The only thing that enemy's fast at is running away.
That's for sure. The only thing that enemy's fast at is running away.
Yes... The only thing that enemy's fast at is running away, isn't it?
...Oh, right.
I found this a little while ago. It seems to be some kind of Gaia Memory, but it looks broken.
It might come in handy somewhere. I'll leave it with you.
Obtained the "Denden Memory".
Hey, Accel... ...Huh? What's this Gaia Memory?
Ah, wait... ...I wonder what kind of Gaia Memory this is?
What kind of Gaia Memory is this...?
What kind of Gaia Memory is this...?
What kind of Gaia Memory is this...?
What kind of Gaia Memory is this...?
Hikari might be able to figure something out... Let's head back to base for now!
Hikari might know something. Let's head back to base for now.
Hikari might be able to figure something out. Let's head back to base for now.
Hikari might be able to figure something out. Let's head back to base for now.
Hikari might be able to figure something out... Okay, let's head back to base for now.
Hikari might know something. All right, let's head back to base for now.
I was just picking out some items that might be useful.
What...? You have a Denden Memory?
Let me take a look at it.
{8074} handed the Denden Memory to Hikari.
Oh... This is... the Denden Memory for the Denden Sensor.
So it was for the Denden Sensor.
Yes. I found the main unit a little while ago. With this, I might be able to fix it.
So the Memory Gadgets got pulled in too.
You know about it?
Of course.
It's a Memory Gadget that makes hidden things visible. It's built from a combination of sensors.
That's right. You certainly know your stuff.
...Actually, Hikari, look who's talking. You sure know a lot yourself.
Believe it or not, I was a Space Science Technology Bureau researcher in the Land of Light.
It may be technology from another world, but the basic design philosophy has a lot in common.
As long as you don't lose sight of that, you can understand how most things work.
That's amazing, Hikari.
Right! Let's get started on the repairs.
Hikari began repairing the Denden Sensor. It looks like it will take a while to finish.
Not a bad place you've got here.
Ankh!!
You're still tagging along with us?
You're just here to collect medals, right?
That's right. But this world has more tough enemies than I expected.
From what I've seen, you lot are about the only ones who can stand up to them.
I like it. So I'll be sticking with you, got it?
If you wanted to join us, you could've just said so.
D-Don't get the wrong idea. I just want to collect medals more efficiently.
Yeah, yeah.
Tch! ...Now that that's settled, let's hurry up and collect those medals.
If we want to learn anything about the enemy, we need to explore deeper in.
"That person"...?
The weather changed again...!?
The weather changed again...!?
The weather changed again...!?
The weather changed again...!?
The weather changed again...!?
It's strangely quiet, isn't it...
It's strangely quiet...
It's way too quiet...
It's strangely quiet...
It's strangely quiet...
You lot!! I've been waitin' for you!! You've got some nerve, wreckin' my army like that!
But! However! The reborn Negataros Army is gonna send you all to hell this time for sure!
Kikikikiki!!
Gyeeeeeh!!
Heh heh heh heh...
Gwaaaargh!!
And that ain't all this time. The great me is gonna be reborn too, that's the plan...
Negataros pulled out the spare Rider Pass and held it over his belt!

notes.note: Unused per script trace of 0141.bla (MessWinSet never shows this row); likely cut content. Party-leader follow-up to 'Accel...!' (same pattern as .55/.57/.59 in story_013), agreeing with Accel's 'too late again'. Speaker assumed to be the preceding row's speaker (Zeta).
Unused per script trace of 0141.bla (MessWinSet never shows this row); likely cut content. Zero variant; 'yarou' rendered 'bastard'.
Unused per script trace of 0141.bla (MessWinSet never shows this row); likely cut content. Mebius variant (softer opener).
Accel (shown). Trailing line break in source dropped. Weather Dopant is male (glossary) -> 'him'.
Unused per script trace of 0141.bla (MessWinSet never shows this row); likely cut content. No speaker; bare farewell, probably Accel leaving in a cut version of the scene. Rendered neutrally.

Unused per script trace of 0141.bla (MessWinSet never shows this row); likely cut content. Rows .68-.73 are six party-leader variants agreeing that the enemy always escapes; order assumed W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius (same order as .80-.85). Wording follows each Japanese variant.
Unused per script trace of 0141.bla (MessWinSet never shows this row); likely cut content. 'him' = Weather Dopant (male).
Item-get format copied from 0124.98 ('Obtained the "Rider Pass".'). Denden Memory = Kamen Rider W Memory Gadget term.
Accel has apparently left after handing over the Memory; Shotaro calls after him, then looks at it.
No speaker; base scene. Rows .93-.112 inferred as Hikari talking with the party (Philip answers the gadget questions). .93-.95, .99, .101, .103, .106, .108-.110, .112 assumed Hikari.
No speaker; assumed party leader / Shotaro.
No speaker; assumed Philip (he answers 'Of course' and explains the gadget in .104-.105). .103 assumed Hikari asking him.
No speaker; assumed Shotaro (casual 'omae koso'). .111 likewise.

Source says 'Ultra no Hoshi' (the Ultras' home star); rendered 'Land of Light' (glossary term for the same place) for clarity. Bureau name per Hikari's official background: Space Science Technology Bureau.
No speaker; Ankh arriving at the base (OOO/leader reacts 'Ankh!!'). .118-.119 are the party's reply, .120-.122/.124/.126 Ankh, .123/.125 party.
Ankh: 'ki ni itta' (I like it) + 'I'm tagging along'. Direction: Ankh announcing he joins them, not asking.
No speaker; could be Ankh continuing or the leader. Subject 'we' restored, which works for either.

Philip echoes Weather Dopant's honorific 'ano okata' from 0141.31 (story_013). Rendered 'A certain someone'; story_013's 0141.31 should use the same phrase ('...especially for a certain someone!') so the echo lands.
Zero variant made a bit more colloquial to fit his voice; same meaning.
'Daga, shikashi' is deliberately redundant bluster; kept as 'But! However!'.
New roars (no earlier English for these Japanese roars): Bat Man 'Kikikikiki!!', Mantis Man 'Gyeeeeeh!!', T-Rex Dopant 'Gwaaaargh!!'.
'Ore-sama' rendered 'the great me' (cf. 'I am the great Negataros!!' in 0124).
proofread: same Japanese as story_013 0141.59; made identical to that row's English.
proofread: Philip echoes Weather Dopant's 'that person' in story_013 0141.31 ('Especially for that person!'); matched the echo.

report: 80/80 rows. Script trace of 0141.bla shows rows 0141.61/.63/.65 and .67-.73 are never displayed (cut content); translated anyway with inferred speakers. Speakers inferred for the unlabelled base scene (.93-.127: Hikari, Philip, Shotaro, Ankh). 0141.133 'A certain someone' must match story_013 row 0141.31. 'Ultra no Hoshi' rendered 'Land of Light'. Not in glossary: Denden Memory, Denden Sensor, Memory Gadget, Space Science Technology Bureau.
